located_point.method: Starting coordinate 23.45,69.05 is the excavator coordinate in Nath et al.2014 p.658, replacing conflicting Wikidata point. No held imagery available for independent mound location.

notes: S1 Fig has a north rose marked N and metric bar, but contour bends and modern rectangles cannot serve as Harappan architectural lines. No bearing selected. Supplementary TIFF was initially stored by generic downloader as source.pdf, then copied byte-for-byte to source.tif for correct decoding; both retained. Acquisition record retains the original hash and content type. No registration.
unmeasurable_reason: No prepared composite; acquired site figure is a contour map with modern structures and no identified straight Harappan architecture.
imagery_assessment: Live manifest at start reports missing-space with no composite.
plan_assessment: Downloaded Pokharia et al.2017 S1 Fig. The legend identifies contour lines and modern structures, not archaeological wall faces. Shell Crafting at Khirsara, Nath et al.2014, has an area-location map and object/work-area illustrations, no calibrated settlement wall plan. A further government PDF lead was a Kendriya Vidyalaya Gujarat school booklet, not an ASI excavation report; excluded.

empirical_error_calibration.sigma_policy: Tool sigma retained unchanged; calibration is separate.
